originality.rationale: The exact forward stationary Beta-product law, Gaussian thermal convolution, angular anisotropy and entropy balance are previously known (Smith et al. 2022); this is explicitly not a new forward distribution or entropy formula. The assessed theorem proves a strict three-cumulant feasible-data region and globally unique inverse for unknown axis, turning rate, speed and thermal noise, with a matching fourth-order ambiguity and sixth-order minimality proof. Closest related published inverse statements cover a distinct zero-speed three-state process or a switching-diffusivity Gaussian mixture. A published biased four-state theorem covers a mixed fourth-order chirality witness but not the symmetric three-parameter inference. Full published theorem statements and primary full-text relevant sections have been compared. Unindexed equivalent inverse deductions remain a publication-priority risk.
